templates.subject: Your Fernbank current account statement is ready
templates.text:
Your statement is ready

Your current account statement for the previous calendar month is now available. Sign in to view or download the PDF.

Account: Personal current account •• 2186
Available from: {date}

In the Fernbank app, select your current account and choose Statements. The statement includes your balance and payments for the period.

Go to Fernbank: https://fernbank.example/

We send this service email to the address registered on your Fernbank accounts. Please do not reply to this address.

Fernbank Bank Ltd, 8 Wren Court, London EC2N 4AX. Registered in England and Wales.

templates.text:

Your statements for the previous calendar month are ready for both of the accounts below.

Personal current account: Ending 2186
Joint current account: Ending 6402
Available from: {date}

You can find the rent standing order under Payments on your joint account statement. Open the account in the app to see the next payment date.
